# Delos Recruitment

> We're a specialist Rec2Rec covering all the roles that make a recruitment business work. That includes trainees, recruiters, sales, marketing, operations, and admin. Anything that helps a recruitment business grow, we recruit for it.

Delos Recruitment Ltd is a specialist Rec2Rec (recruitment to recruitment) business founded in April 2025 by Maria Gripari, Founder and Director. Based in Surrey, working primarily across the South East and throughout the UK. Company number 16163283, registered in England and Wales.

## Pages

- [Home](https://delosrecruitment.co.uk/): what Delos does and who it is for
- [Hiring](https://delosrecruitment.co.uk/hiring.html): for recruitment businesses hiring trainees, recruiters, sales, marketing, operations and admin
- [Careers](https://delosrecruitment.co.uk/careers.html): for people thinking about a move into recruitment
- [About](https://delosrecruitment.co.uk/about.html): who Delos is and how we work
- [Jobs](https://delosrecruitment.co.uk/jobs.html): current roles (none listed at the moment)
